title: Why I love living in a small town
text:
Hi! I'm Tomek and I live in Sandomierz, a small town in the south-east of Poland. Five years ago I lived in Warsaw, but I moved here with my wife and our two children. People often ask me, "Isn't it boring?" My answer is: no!

First, life is slower and calmer. I walk to work in ten minutes – no traffic jams! In Warsaw I spent two hours a day in the car. Now I have time for my family and my hobby, photography.

Second, people here know each other. The woman in the bakery knows my name, and my neighbours help us when we need it. My children play outside with their friends after school.

Of course, there are some disadvantages. There is no big cinema or theatre, and some shops close at 6 p.m. When we want to see a concert, we drive to Kraków or Lublin. Also, the salaries here are lower.

But for me, the advantages are bigger. The air is clean, the town is beautiful and our life is happier. What about you – city or small town?
